headline: Engineered for patrollers. Built for your metrics.
body: Optimize your cold-weather output with pro-grade shells designed for serious backcountry climate regulation. Transparent material specs for peak physiological performance.
rationale: This copy targets the Wellness Optimizer by framing the technical ski shell as a precision tool for physiological optimization and climate regulation. It avoids lifestyle fluff, directly uses her preferred scientific and outcome-focused framing, and ignores price entirely due to her low price sensitivity.
